_note: Interest rates and write-off rules for UK student loans, used by tools/build-student-loan-pages.js. Repayment thresholds and rates are NOT here: they are read from the UK tax file (data/tax/gb/), which the monthly check keeps current. Interest rates are as GOV.UK states them 'currently'; they change each September (RPI) and when caps are announced. Write-off assumes loans first paid on or after 1 September 2006 (Plan 1) or 1 August 2007 (Plan 4); earlier loans are written off at 65.

plan1.name: Plan 1
plan1.who: English and Welsh students who started before September 2012, and Northern Irish students

plan2.name: Plan 2
plan2.who: English and Welsh students who started between September 2012 and July 2023

plan5.name: Plan 5
plan5.who: English students who started on or after 1 August 2023

postgrad.name: Postgraduate Loan
postgrad.who: English and Welsh Master's and Doctoral loans

sources.title: Repaying your student loan: what you pay (GOV.UK)
sources.note: Thresholds (match the tax file), 9% / 6%; 'You're currently charged' 4.1% Plan 1, 4 and 5, 6% Postgraduate; Plan 2 sliding scale 4.1% at £29,385 or less, 4.1% plus up to 1.9% from £29,386 to £52,884, 6% at £52,885 or more (cap of 6%).

sources.title: When your student loan gets written off or cancelled (GOV.UK)
sources.note: Plan 1 25 years after the April first due (loans from 1 Sep 2006); Plan 2 30 years; Plan 4 30 years (loans from 1 Aug 2007); Plan 5 40 years; Postgraduate 30 years.
